The '''Brightday system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Another system was named similarly: the [[Upper Brightday system/Legends|Upper Brightday system]].<ref name="EAOC" />
